sb.name: Dread Linnorm
sb.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the linnorm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The linnorm has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The linnorm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dread linnorm makes one Bite attack and two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) damage of a type chosen by the linnorm: Cold or Fire. If the target is a creature, it gains 1 Exhaustion level, and the linnorm regains 5 (1d10) Hit Points. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it automatically fails its saving throws against the linnorm's Twin Breath.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Twin Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 27 (5d10) Cold damage and 27 (5d10) Fire damage. Success: Half damage only.

legendary_actions.name: Slithering Strike
legendary_actions.desc: The linnorm moves up to half its speed and uses Bite.

legendary_actions.name: Stone Wall
legendary_actions.desc: The linnorm casts [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Stone|Wall of Stone]], requiring no components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (DC 18). The linnorm can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Sweep
legendary_actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature of the linnorm's choice in a 5-foot Emanation. Failure: 17 (2d8 + 8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3 (4 in its lair). One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Fire Aura (Fire Form Only)
traits.desc: At the end of each of the firre's turns, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the firre takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Flammable objects in the Emanation start burning.

actions.name: Multiattack (Eladrin Form Only)
actions.desc: The firre makes a Burning Blade attack and uses Flaming Gaze.

actions.name: Burning Blade (Eladrin Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Flaming Gaze
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the firre can see within 60 feet. Failure: 11 (2d6 + 4) Fire damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the firre's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.desc: The firre shape-shifts into a Medium column of fire (Speed 50 ft.), or it returns to its eladrin form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Anything it is wearing transforms with it. While in fire form, the firre can't manipulate objects.

traits.name: Aura of Bravery
traits.desc: Creatures of the valkyrie's choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from it have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened condition while there.

traits.name: Mounted Adept
traits.desc: While mounted and without the Incapacitated condition, the valkyrie and its mount have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and the valkyrie can force an attack targeted at its mount to target the valkyrie instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The valkyrie makes three attacks, using Longsword or Radiant Javelin in any combination.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Javelin
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

reactions.name: Valorous Rebuke (3/Day)
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the valkyrie can see moves within 5 feet of it. Response: The valkyrie makes one Longsword attack against the creature. On a hit, the attack deals an additional 14 (4d6) Radiant damage.
